title: fix(components): filter-builder renderer hands onChange the declared FilterGroup
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi979uT1nAyKwVX3CFRQGb43w)_
Fixes #26382

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`filter-builder` 渲染器调用 `onChange` 时直接传 `FilterGroup`,不再传 `{ target: { name, value } }` 表单事件；渲染器自己的 `onChange` 类型改为 `FilterBuilderSchema['onChange']`,去掉了那个 `any`。
- **为什么改**:schema 声明 `onChange(filter: FilterGroup)`,渲染器却传事件对象，按声明写的处理函数读 `.logic` / `.conditions` 只会拿到 `undefined`,而 `any` 让编译器看不见。仓内没有任何宿主按事件形状绑定这个节点，所以以声明为准。
- **风险与回滚**:低。仓外若有宿主读 `event.target.value`,要改成直接读参数(changeset 已写明)。宿主经节点转发的 `extraOperators` 不再传进构建器，所以本节点永远不提供 `exists` / `notExists`;若存储的 value 绕过校验仍带这类运算符，渲染器不调用 `onChange`,并在 console 报出该运算符，不会抛错，也不会传出错的形状。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/filter-builder.tsx`(`extraOperators` 的解构、`isAuthoredFilterGroup` 与 `handleChange`);`ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-renderer-onchange-26382.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-renderer-onchange-26382.test.tsx`,预期 5 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/filter-builder.tsx`: the renderer's `onChange` prop is typed `FilterBuilderSchema['onChange']` instead of `(event: any) => void`, and `handleChange` is typed on the builder's `FilterBuilderRowGroup` instead of `any`. It calls `onChange(group)` with the group itself.
- The builder's row type admits two opt-in operators (`exists` / `notExists`) that `FilterGroup` cannot carry, so `FilterBuilderRowGroup` is not assignable to `FilterGroup` (measured, below). The renderer narrows through a type predicate, `isAuthoredFilterGroup`, that checks every row's operator against the spec's `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`.
- The renderer takes `extraOperators` out of the host spread and never forwards it to `FilterBuilder`. It is the builder's only operator-granting prop, `FilterBuilderSchema` declares no such key, and what it grants (`exists` / `notExists`) is outside the declared `FilterGroup`. So the node's dropdown offers only protocol operators, and the off-contract branch cannot be reached from the node.
- The one way left into that branch is a stored `value` row that skipped the `FilterGroup` zod mirror, which refuses such an operator. There the renderer does not call `onChange` and logs a `console.error` naming the operator. It does not hand on a group the declared type does not describe, and it does not throw inside a click handler. `isAuthoredFilterGroup` stays as the type guard. No `as any` or other cast remains on the path.
- `FilterBuilderSchema` in `@object-ui/types` is unchanged: the declaration is the contract.
- One root changeset, `.changeset/26382-filter-builder-onchange-group.md` (`@object-ui/components` patch).

### Step 1: which side is the contract (the triage's measurement)

Searched `ui/` and `packages/` on `origin/main` for every host that could bind a `filter-builder` node's `onChange` through the event shape. Nothing does, so the renderer adopts the declared `FilterGroup` (`Clause-②: no`).

- **Form field hosts:** `renderFieldComponent` in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` resolves only `field:`-namespaced widgets for a form field. The `filter-builder` node is registered in the `ui` namespace, and no `field:filter-builder` registration exists. A form field never reaches this renderer.
- **SchemaRenderer host props:** `SchemaRenderer` spreads the host's `...props` last, so a host's `onChange` would reach the renderer. The only in-repo hosts that pass `onChange` to `SchemaRenderer` are two cases in `plugin-view`'s `handlerEventNameThroughRenderer-10616.test.tsx`, and neither renders a `filter-builder` node.
- **Metadata-admin `filter-builder` widget:** the spec's form rows (`view.form.ts`, `page.form.ts`, `dataset.form.ts`) name `widget: 'filter-builder'`. That key resolves to `FilterBuilderWidget` in app-shell's `metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`, which draws `FilterBuilderField` over `FilterRuleLite[]`, and `ObjectListViewInspector` reads the same `WIDGETS` entry. Neither renders the `filter-builder` SDUI node, so neither reaches this `onChange`.
- **Docs and examples:** `ui/content/docs/components/complex/filter-builder.mdx` declares `onChange?: (filter: FilterGroup) => void`, the same as the type. The five `ui/examples/schema-catalog` JSON documents carry no function, and their tests (`filter-builder-mirror-6939`, `filter-builder-operator-alias-trigger-7561`, `filter-builder-operator-vocabulary-6939`) read no `onChange`.
- **Other hits:** the `@object-ui/types` tests, `inline-locale-label-read-sites.test.tsx`, `known-schema-types.ts`, `widget-dom-leak-sweep.test.tsx` and `shadcn-components.json` name the type but bind no `onChange` and read no `target`.
- Not searchable from here: the `objectstack-ai/cloud` and `hotcrm` repositories.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-renderer-onchange-26382.test.tsx` invokes the registered renderer directly:
  - a host `onChange` gets the group, with no `target`, the group's `logic`, the existing row and the added row;
  - a handler typed from `FilterBuilderSchema`'s own `onChange` (checked with `satisfies`), the channel a node-authored `onChange` arrives on, gets the same group;
  - a host forwarding `extraOperators: ['exists', 'notExists']` through the node gets an operator dropdown that offers neither `Is set` nor `Is not set` (and does offer `Is empty`, so the dropdown really opened);
  - a stored row holding `exists` (off contract) makes the renderer skip `onChange` and log one `console.error` naming the operator;
  - type level: `expectTypeOf` pins `FilterBuilderSchema['onChange']`'s parameter EQUAL to `FilterGroup`, and a `@ts-expect-error` pins that a handler taking the old `{ target: { name, value } }` event is not assignable to it. The file is compiled by the components `tsconfig.test.json` project, which `type-check` runs.
- No existing test needed an edit.

## Acceptance notes

- Seat ruling on the off-contract branch: close it at its source, so the renderer stops forwarding `extraOperators`. On the remaining branch, the choice was a throw kept as an invariant, or `console.error` and skip the emit. This PR picks `console.error` and skip. The branch is not fully unreachable (a stored `value` that skipped validation still reaches it), so a throw there would still be a crash in the user's hands.
- The renderer still spreads the other undeclared host props into `FilterBuilder`, as before. `extraOperators` is the only one that grants operators, and it is now held back. No in-repo host forwarded it.

## Verification

<details><summary>components type-check (tsc --noEmit, then tsc -p tsconfig.test.json)</summary>

`os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0`, with the new test file in the test project.
</details>

<details><summary>vitest: new file plus inline-locale-label-read-sites</summary>

`Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 10 passed (10)`; after the extraOperators round: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 12 passed (12)` (the new file: 5).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 1: call reverted to the event shape</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `onChange(group);` with the old `{ target: { name, value } }` call (anchor 1 → 0, blob `96162878fc0f` → `ece34562e098`). Two tests went red: `expected { target: { name: 'filters', …(1) } } to not have property "target"` and `Target cannot be null or undefined.` (`Tests 2 failed | 2 passed`). Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 3: extraOperators forwarded again</summary>

`extraOperators: _refusedExtraOperators,` removed from the destructure, so the spread forwards it again (blob `5645f25cbc23` → `57047d781a2f`): `expected [ 'Equals', 'Does not equal', …(11) ] to not include 'Is set'`, `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 4: skip-emit return removed</summary>

The `return;` after the `console.error` replaced with a no-op marker (blob `5645f25cbc23` → `8a937573edee`): `expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times`, `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD. A first attempt was refused by `ablation-replace` before any run, because its replacement text was a substring of the anchor (the count did not rise), so it was a no-op and not a reading.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation 2: type guard removed (is it load-bearing?)</summary>

With the predicate replaced by `false as boolean`, `tsc --noEmit` reported `TS2345: Argument of type 'FilterBuilderRowGroup' is not assignable to parameter of type 'FilterGroup'`, down to `Type '"exists"' is not assignable to …`. Restored: blob equal to HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Full components suite</summary>

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/components test --maxWorkers=2` under the lock at `070b433f`: `Test Files 438 passed | 1 skipped (439)`, `Tests 4273 passed | 24 skipped (4297)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

After the extraOperators round, narrowed and declared as such at `904e58cf`: every `filter-builder*` file in `packages/components/src/__tests__/` (22) plus `inline-locale-label-read-sites`: `Test Files 23 passed (23)`, `Tests 392 passed (392)`. components `type-check` at `904e58cf`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
